typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DELTA as boolean (),
	LoopCtr as integer (),
	SourceA_DataSource as string (),
	SourceA_InitialCatalog as string (),
	SourceA_Pwd as string (),
	SourceA_UserName as string (),
	TargetA_DataSource as string (),
	TargetA_InitialCatalog as string (),
	TargetA_Pwd as string (),
	TargetA_UserName as string ()
}

source(output(
		MEME_CK as integer,
		GROUP_CK as integer,
		CONCEPT_ID as integer,
		USER_ID as integer,
		EFF_DATE as integer,
		EFF_TIME as integer,
		TERM_DATE as integer,
		TERM_TIME as integer,
		Option_ID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  DISTINCT MEME_CK, 	GROUP_CK, 	CONCEPT_ID, 	USER_ID, 	EFF_DATE, 	EFF_TIME, 	TERM_DATE, 	TERM_TIME,       Split.a.value(\'.\', \'INT\') AS Option_ID    FROM    (      SELECT  MEME_CK, 	GROUP_CK, 	CONCEPT_ID, 	[User ID] AS USER_ID, 	EFF_DATE, 	EFF_TIME, 	TERM_DATE, 	TERM_TIME,            CAST (\'<M>\' + REPLACE(CONCEPT_VALUE, \',\', \'</M><M>\') + \'</M>\' AS XML) AS Option_ID        FROM  [APP_CPLS].[NJ_REG_521993] WITH(NOLOCK)   ) AS A CROSS APPLY Option_ID.nodes (\'/M\') AS Split(a)    ORDER by MEME_CK,EFF_DATE,CONCEPT_ID,Option_ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> NJREG521993	source(output(
		CONCEPT_KEY as integer,
		CONCEPT_ID as integer,
		OPTION_ID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  CONCEPT_KEY, CONCEPT_ID, OPTION_ID   FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CONCEPT WITH (NOLOCK)    WHERE CONCEPT_ID=521993 ORDER BY CONCEPT_ID,OPTION_ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LKPCONCEPTKEYLKPTABLE
NJREG521993,LKPCONCEPTKEYLKPTABLE lookup(NJREG521993@CONCEPT_ID == LKPCONCEPTKEYLKPTABLE@CONCEPT_ID && NJREG521993@Option_ID == LKPCONCEPTKEYLKPTABLE@OPTION_ID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LKPCONCEPTKEY
LKPCONCEPTKEY select(mapColumn(
		MEME_CK = MEME_CK,
		GROUP_CK = GROUP_CK,
		CONCEPT_ID = NJREG521993@CONCEPT_ID,
		USER_ID = USER_ID,
		EFF_DATE = EFF_DATE,
		EFF_TIME = EFF_TIME,
		TERM_DATE = TERM_DATE,
		TERM_TIME = TERM_TIME,
		Option_ID = NJREG521993@Option_ID,
		CONCEPT_KEY = CONCEPT_KEY,
		OPTION_ID = NJREG521993@Option_ID
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LKPCONCEPTKEYSelect
LKPCONCEPTKEYSelect filter(isMatch()) ~> FilterLKPCONCEPTKEY
FilterLKPCONCEPTKEY sink(input(
		CONCEPT_KEY as integer,
		ANSWER as string,
		TERM_DATE as integer,
		USER_ID as integer,
		MEME_CK as integer,
		EFF_DATE as integer,
		TERM_TIME as integer,
		GROUP_CK as integer,
		EFF_TIME as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CONCEPT_KEY,
		ANSWER = Option_ID,
		TERM_DATE,
		USER_ID,
		MEME_CK,
		EFF_DATE,
		TERM_TIME,
		GROUP_CK,
		EFF_TIME)) ~> TGTDWFACTMEMBERCONCEPT
